rationale: W1 U01a retires the knowledge surface: `serve` no longer composes the OKF index, so serve.go no longer binds :11436. The memory and broker pins are unchanged — this waiver narrows the pin to the two ports the supervisor still binds, it does not relax it.
evidence: services/host/cmd/pix/corpus/retirement.jsonl (approved entries for `knowledge`/`kb` and `pix-host serve knowledge`); services/host/retired.go; services/host/serve.go serveServiceAliases()

rationale: W2 U02B deletes the built-in `pix gworkspace setup --create-docs` wizard and the separate google-docs-create write-scoped MCP it provisioned (workflow/gworkspace, google_docs_create_plugin.go). google_workspace_access was the get-only permission profile that wizard wrote and nothing else ever read once the wizard is gone, so it drops from the top-level key surface. google_workspace_account is UNCHANGED: gog stays registerable the generic way every other local stdio MCP server is, via `pix mcp register` (mcp.GogHardenedArgv already bakes in --readonly/--gmail-no-send/--wrap-untrusted).
evidence: docs/design/gworkspace-externalization.md; services/host/config/config.go (GoogleWorkspaceAccess field + SetGoogleWorkspaceAccess removed); services/host/workflow/setup/config.go (google_workspace_access get-key case removed)
